lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy6Mn2 (reduced formula Dy3Mn) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy centers with 11 geometric neighbors (8 Dy, 3 Mn) and Mn centers with 9 Dy neighbors, while a second Dy environment has 12 neighbors (6 Dy, 6 Mn). Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Dy and Mn coordination polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites.
